reviewed.by: owner — picker ruling 2026-10-18 and the FLUX ruling of 2026-10-23 (art-provenance.md section 8, decision 1)

prompt.text:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: a BLACK-SMOKER sea vent — a rock collar with a dark rim around a glowing opening, warm light welling from the crack. The palette: deep navy-teals #15263a #10323e #184658 #0e3e50 with pale foam #b8e8f0 highlights and warm gold #d8a018 accents, near-black navy outline — the BRINE NEBULA zone.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- REFINED PULSE: frame 0 is the FULL glow — bright wide core, body ring, faint halo at maximum size; frame 1 shrinks the core by a clear 30 percent and pulls ring and halo one step dimmer and smaller — the two frames must be visibly different, not near-copies.
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure BLACK background, exactly hex #000000, identical solid black in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no stars, no floor plane — this is ADDITIVE glow art: brightness is opacity, so everything visible sits on pure black and the dim halo fades smoothly INTO the black.
- EXACTLY 2 equal square cells laid out as TWO cells in ONE row of TWO (2 columns by 1 row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom): the SAME subject, lying HORIZONTALLY (wider than tall, about 1.5:1), centred in its cell at the same scale — ONLY the named state changes between cells; the silhouette stays identical in all cells.
  cell 1 = glow steady: bright core, body ring, faint wide halo; cell 2 = pulse: the whole glow one step SMALLER and softer.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 30 px of unbroken flat #000000 around it and clean flat gutters between cells.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge (outline only around the bright core, fading out in the halo), no anti-aliasing, no motion blur.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
